candidate_proof:
cases s with
| nil =>
  simp [next?, Option.map, toList, List.next?]
| cons v r tail =>
  simp [next?, Option.map, toList, List.next?]
  <;>
  (try simp_all [toStream_toList']) <;>
  (try aesop) <;>
  (try
    {
      rw [toStream_toList']
    }) <;>
  (try simp_all [List.cons_append, List.append_assoc]) <;>
  (try aesop)
